claim: Seq1F1B measures 2.7B GPT training throughput on 8xA100 with PP=8 falling from 37.3k tok/s at 16k sequence length to 32.6k at 24k to 28.8k at 32k, while per-device TFLOPs stays essentially flat (113.1 -> 115.2 -> 116.5).
stance_target: the claim that for a 2.7B model with pipeline parallelism, the FLOPs ratio converts to wall-clock at roughly constant MFU
scope_conditions: 2.7B GPT, PP size 8, 8xA100, micro-batch 16, Seq1F1B partition

claim: For a 7B GPT with PP=4 and TP=8 on 32xA100, Seq1F1B's per-device TFLOPs RISES with sequence length (110.6 at 32k, 124.6 at 64k, 136.7 at 128k) while throughput falls (53.5k, 43.3k, 30.4k tok/s), so the wall-clock penalty is smaller than the FLOPs penalty at very long context.
stance_target: the assumption that the FLOPs ratio is an upper bound on the wall-clock penalty at long context
scope_conditions: 7B GPT, PP size 4, TP size 8, 32xA100, micro-batch 8
